bookSourceComment:
主链路（搜索/详情/目录/正文）走自建后端 fanqie_backend.py（锁章全文、图片、PUA 解密）。
发现页公开分类走自建后端 /api/v1/search，免登录、免设备签名；仅「个人中心/我的书架」需要网页登录 cookie（java.getCookie）。
登录方式：在「登录」里点【账号登录】用内置浏览器登录 fanqienovel.com。
jsLib/loginUrl/loginUi 移植自 shareBookSource.json；解析规则兼容归一化格式、App 原始结构与 Web 原始结构。

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
// 搜索结果兼容：①自建后端归一化 data.search_book_data_list[*].book_data
//                ②App 原始 data.ret_data[*]（title 带 <em>）
//                ③search_tabs[*].data[*]  ④顶层数组
function __toJson(x){
  if (typeof x === 'string') { try { return JSON.parse(x); } catch(e){ return {}; } }
  return x || {};
}
function __clean(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/<\/?em>/g, ''); }
var j = __toJson(result);
var list = [];
var seen = {};
function add(b){
  if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') return;
  var id = String(b.book_id || b.bookId || '');
  if (!id || seen[id]) return;
  seen[id] = 1;
  list.push({
    book_id: id,
    book_name: __clean(b.book_name || b.bookName || b.title),
    author_name: __clean(b.author_name || b.authorName || b.author),
    abstract: __clean(b.abstract || b.book_abstract || b.intro || b.description),
    category: __clean(b.category || b.genre),
    new_chapter_title: __clean(b.new_chapter_title || b.last_chapter_title || b.lastChapterTitle),
    cover_url: b.cover_url || b.thumb_url || b.thumbUrl || b.coverUrl || '',
    word_number: b.word_number || b.wordNumber || ''
  });
}
try {
  var d = j.data || j;
  var a = d.search_book_data_list || [];
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) add(a[i].book_data || a[i]);
  var r = d.ret_data || [];
  for (var k = 0; k < r.length; k++) add(r[k]);
  var tabs = j.search_tabs || [];
  for (var m = 0; m < tabs.length; m++) {
    var td = (tabs[m] && tabs[m].data) || [];
    for (var n = 0; n < td.length; n++) add(td[n].book_data || td[n]);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(j)) for (var q = 0; q < j.length; q++) add(j[q]);
} catch (e) { java.log('搜索解析失败: ' + e); }
JSON.stringify(list);
</js>$[*]

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
// 目录兼容：①归一化 data.chapterListWithVolume[*].chapterList[*].{chapter_title,itemId}
//           ②Web 原始 data.chapterListWithVolume[*] 是二维数组 [{title,itemId,...}]
//           ③App 原始 data.item_data_list[*].{title,item_id}
var __toJson = function(x){
  if (typeof x === 'string') { try { return JSON.parse(x); } catch(e){ return {}; } }
  return x || {};
};
var __clean = function(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s); };
var j = __toJson(result);
var d = j.data || j;
function add(c, out, seen){
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return;
  var id = String(c.itemId || c.item_id || c.itemID || '');
  if (!id || seen[id]) return;
  seen[id] = 1;
  out.push({
    itemId: id,
    chapter_title: __clean(c.chapter_title || c.title || c.chapterName),
    firstPassTime: c.firstPassTime || c.first_pass_time || '',
    chapterWordNumber: c.chapterWordNumber || c.chapter_word_number || ''
  });
}
var out = [], seen = {};
try {
  var vols = d.chapterListWithVolume || [];
  for (var i = 0; i < vols.length; i++) {
    var v = vols[i];
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      for (var a = 0; a < v.length; a++) add(v[a], out, seen);
    } else if (v && v.chapterList) {
      for (var b = 0; b < v.chapterList.length; b++) add(v.chapterList[b], out, seen);
    }
  }
  var items = d.item_data_list || d.itemDataList || [];
  for (var k = 0; k < items.length; k++) add(items[k], out, seen);
  if (Array.isArray(d)) for (var q = 0; q < d.length; q++) add(d[q], out, seen);
} catch (e) { java.log('目录解析失败: ' + e); }
JSON.stringify(out);
</js>$[*]

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
// 发现页列表：公开分类用搜索返回；书架用 getBookId + multi-detail 重建书卡
function __toJson(x) {
  if (x == null) return null
  if (typeof x === 'string') { try { return JSON.parse(x) } catch (e) { return null } }
  if (typeof x === 'object') {
    // 兼容 java.ajax 返回 Java String 对象：String(x) 就是 JSON 文本
    try {
      var str = String(x)
      if (str && str.charAt(0) === '{') return JSON.parse(str)
    } catch (e) {}
    return x
  }
  try { return JSON.parse(String(x)) } catch (e) { return null }
}
function __s(v) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/<\/?em>/g, '') }

function __idOf(x) {
  return String((x && (x.book_id || x.book_id_str || x.bookId)) || '')
}
var ID_KEYS = ['book_shelf_info', 'data_list', 'book_list', 'books', 'book_info', 'group_list', 'groups', 'list']
function __walk(node, out, depth) {
  if (!node || depth > 5) return
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    for (var i = 0; i < node.length; i++) {
      var item = node[i]
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue
      var id = __idOf(item)
      if (id) out.push(id)
      else __walk(item, out, depth + 1)
    }
    return
  }
  if (typeof node !== 'object') return
  var selfId = __idOf(node)
  if (selfId) out.push(selfId)
  for (var k = 0; k < ID_KEYS.length; k++) {
    if (node[ID_KEYS[k]]) __walk(node[ID_KEYS[k]], out, depth + 1)
  }
}
function __ids(raw) {
  var j = __toJson(raw), out = [], seen = {}
  __walk((j && j.data) || j || {}, out, 0)
  return out.filter(function (id) {
    if (!id || seen[id]) return false
    seen[id] = 1
    return true
  })
}
function __collectBooks(node, out, depth) {
  if (!node || depth > 5) return
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    for (var i = 0; i < node.length; i++) __collectBooks(node[i], out, depth + 1)
    return
  }
  if (typeof node !== 'object') return
  var id = __idOf(node)
  if (id && (node.book_name || node.bookName || node.title || node.thumb_url || node.cover_url)) out.push(node)
  for (var k = 0; k < ID_KEYS.length; k++) {
    if (node[ID_KEYS[k]]) __collectBooks(node[ID_KEYS[k]], out, depth + 1)
  }
}

function __cookie() {
  var c = ''
  try { c = java.getCookie('fanqienovel.com') || '' } catch (e) {}
  if (!c && typeof cookie !== 'undefined' && cookie.getKey) {
    try { var s = cookie.getKey('fanqienovel.com', 'sessionid'); if (s) c = 'sessionid=' + s } catch (e) {}
  }
  if (!c && source.getLoginInfoMap) {
    var m = source.getLoginInfoMap()
    var t = m && m['手动登录Token']
    if (t) c = 'sessionid=' + t
  }
  return c
}

var SHELF_URL = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

function __multi(ids, progress) {
  var books = [], have = {}, chunks = [], urls = [], responses = []
  function pushValid(b) {
    if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') return
    var id = __idOf(b)
    if (!id || have[id]) return
    have[id] = 1
    books.push(b)
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 100) chunks.push(ids.slice(i, i + 100))
  for (var k = 0; k < chunks.length; k++) {
    try { urls.push(xGorgon('multi-detail', 'book_id=' + chunks[k].join(','))) } catch (e) { java.log('multi-detail 签名失败: ' + e) }
  }
  if (urls.length) {
    try {
      responses = java.ajaxAll ? java.ajaxAll(urls) : urls.map(function (u) {
        return { body: function () { return java.ajax(u) } }
      })
    } catch (e) { java.log('multi-detail 请求失败: ' + e) }
  }
  for (var r = 0; r < responses.length; r++) {
    try {
      var mj = __toJson(responses[r].body())
      var ma = (mj && mj.data) || []
      for (var m = 0; m < ma.length; m++) pushValid(ma[m])
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  java.log('multi-detail 有效书卡=' + books.length)

  // 对仍然缺书卡的 ID，用自建后端详情并发补全
  var missing = []
  for (var n = 0; n < ids.length && n < 200; n++) {
    var key = String(ids[n])
    if (key && !have[key]) missing.push(key)
  }
  java.log('需补全ID列表=' + JSON.stringify(missing))
  if (missing.length) {
    function fillFrom(urls, mapper) {
      var before = books.length, res = []
      try {
        res = java.ajaxAll ? java.ajaxAll(urls) : []
      } catch (e) { java.log('补全请求失败: ' + e) }
      for (var x = 0; x < res.length; x++) {
        try {
          var rawBody = res[x].body()
          if (x === 0) java.log('补全首响=' + String(rawBody || '').slice(0, 200))
          var rj = __toJson(rawBody)
          var b = mapper((rj && rj.data) || rj || {})
          if (__idOf(b)) pushValid(b)
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      // ajaxAll 返回空或无效时，逐个 java.ajax 重试
      if (books.length === before) {
        for (var y = 0; y < urls.length; y++) {
          try {
            var sraw = java.ajax(urls[y])
            if (y === 0) java.log('逐个补全首响=' + String(sraw || '').slice(0, 200))
            var sj = __toJson(sraw)
            var sb = mapper((sj && sj.data) || sj || {})
            if (__idOf(sb)) pushValid(sb)
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
    }
    // 自建后端详情补全
    var miss2 = []
    for (var q = 0; q < missing.length; q++) if (!have[missing[q]]) miss2.push(missing[q])
    var base = String(source.bookSourceUrl || '').replace(/\/$/, '')
    if (miss2.length) {
      var durls = miss2.map(function (id) { return base + '/api/v1/books/' + id + '/detail' })
      fillFrom(durls, function (d) { return d })
      java.log('后端补全后=' + books.length)
      // 并发不可用或仍缺失时，逐本兜底
      var still = []
      for (var r = 0; r < miss2.length && r < 100; r++) if (!have[miss2[r]]) still.push(miss2[r])
      for (var z = 0; z < still.length; z++) {
        try {
          var sj = __toJson(java.ajax(base + '/api/v1/books/' + still[z] + '/detail'))
          var sd = (sj && sj.data) || {}
          if (__idOf(sd)) pushValid(sd)
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  }
  java.log('补全后书卡=' + books.length)
  if (progress) {
    for (var p = 0; p < books.length; p++) {
      var bid = __idOf(books[p])
      if (progress[bid] != null) books[p].read_progress = progress[bid]
    }
  }
  return { book_info: books }
}

function __shelfBooks(rawResult) {
  // 优先复用阅读器已经取到的书架响应，避免重复请求或 cookie 上下文不一致
  var raw = rawResult || ''
  var first = __toJson(raw)
  if (!first || first.code !== 0 || !first.data) {
    raw = ''
    try { raw = java.ajax(SHELF_URL + ', ' + JSON.stringify({ headers: { Cookie: __cookie() } })) } catch (e) { java.log('书架接口失败: ' + e) }
  } else {
    java.log('复用已获取的书架响应')
  }
  java.log('书架响应长度=' + String(raw || '').length + ' 片段=' + String(raw || '').slice(0, 160))
  var j = __toJson(raw), d = (j && j.data) || {}, prog = {}, direct = []
  __collectBooks(d, direct, 0)
  function markProgress(node) {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return
    var id = __idOf(node)
    if (id && node.read_progress != null) prog[id] = node.read_progress
    for (var k = 0; k < ID_KEYS.length; k++) if (node[ID_KEYS[k]]) markProgress(node[ID_KEYS[k]])
  }
  markProgress(d)
  for (var n = 0; n < direct.length; n++) {
    var cp = {}, item = direct[n]
    for (var key in item) cp[key] = item[key]
    cp.book_id = __idOf(item)
    direct[n] = cp
  }
  var ids = __ids(raw).filter(function (id) {
    for (var m = 0; m < direct.length; m++) if (String(direct[m].book_id) === id) return false
    return true
  })
  java.log('书架 ID 数=' + ids.length + ' 自带书卡数=' + direct.length)
  var extra = __multi(ids, prog)
  java.log('书架补全书卡数=' + (extra.book_info || []).length)
  return { book_info: direct.concat(extra.book_info || []) }
}

var bu = String(baseUrl || '')
var data
if (/fqbookshelf|bookshelf\/info/.test(bu)) data = __shelfBooks(result)
else data = __toJson(result)

var out = [], seen = {}
function add(b) {
  if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') return
  var id = String(b.book_id || b.book_id_str || b.bookId || b.item_id || '')
  if (!id || seen[id]) return
  seen[id] = 1
  out.push({
    book_id: id,
    book_name: __s(b.book_name || b.bookName || b.title || b.name),
    author: __s(b.author_name || b.authorName || b.author),
    abstract: __s(b.abstract || b.intro || b.description || b.book_abstract),
    thumb_url: b.thumb_url || b.cover_url || b.coverUrl || b.thumbUrl || '',
    word_number: b.word_number || b.wordNumber || '',
    category: __s(b.category || b.genre || b.complete_category),
    score: b.score || '',
    creation_status: b.creation_status || '',
    gender: b.gender || '',
    read_progress: (b.read_progress != null ? b.read_progress : ''),
    text: __s(b.text || b.sub_info || b.subInfo || '')
  })
}
try {
  var d = (data && data.data) || data || {}
  var lists = []
  var tabs = (data && data.search_tabs) || d.search_tabs || []
  for (var t = 0; t < tabs.length; t++) {
    var td = (tabs[t] && tabs[t].data) || []
    for (var n = 0; n < td.length; n++) lists.push(td[n].book_data || td[n])
  }
  var sn = d.search_book_data_list || []
  for (var s = 0; s < sn.length; s++) lists.push(sn[s].book_data || sn[s])
  var bi = d.book_info || d.bookInfo || d.detail_list || d.data_list || d.dataList || []
  for (var k = 0; k < bi.length; k++) lists.push(bi[k].book_data || bi[k])
  if (Array.isArray(data)) lists = data.concat(lists)
  if (Array.isArray(d)) lists = lists.concat(d)
  for (var i = 0; i < lists.length; i++) add(lists[i])
} catch (e) { java.log('发现页解析失败: ' + e) }
java.log('发现页解析完成: ' + bu.split(',')[0] + ' | 数量=' + out.length)
if (/fqbookshelf|bookshelf\/info/.test(bu) && out.length === 0) java.toast('书架为空或书卡补全失败，请查看调试日志')
JSON.stringify(out)
</js>$[*]
